_note: Committed TEMPLATE - human reference and local dry-runs only. Pipelines never read it at runtime (they use ADO variable groups / Key Vault). The populated copy is demo-ids.local.json (gitignored): infra/deploy.ps1 or the azd postprovision hook writes the flat Azure keys, and seeds the `corpus` block below on first write. Every key is documented in docs/13-configuration-reference.md section 3.

_meta.description: Template for demo-ids.local.json — the per-deployment ID file this pattern produces. The live file is HYBRID: Azure resource fields (flat top-level keys) are auto-written by infra/deploy.ps1 or the azd postprovision hook from the Bicep deploymentSummary and overwritten on every successful deploy; nested objects (corpus, fabric, sp-rag-di-caller, copilotStudio) are maintained by hand and preserved across deploys (the writer merges rather than overwrites). The live file is gitignored — never commit a populated copy.
_meta.azureFieldsSource: infra/main.bicep deploymentSummary output (written by infra/deploy.ps1 or infra/hooks/postprovision.ps1)
consumedBy: scripts/post_deploy_search.py (reads top-level Azure fields: foundryOpenAIEndpoint, embeddingDeployment, embeddingModel, searchService, searchEndpoint, searchIndexName, searchDataSourceName, searchIndexerName, storageAccount, chunksContainer, resourceGroup, subscriptionId; and the corpus block)
Fabric pipeline pl_ingest_docs (operator copies fabric.*, sp-rag-di-caller.* and corpus chunking values into pipeline / notebook parameters at build time — see docs/06-fabric-setup.md § F8.0)
Agent setup (operator copies corpus.agentName / knowledgeSourceName / knowledgeSourceDescription into Copilot Studio or the Foundry agent — docs/07, docs/08)

corpus._note: THE ONLY corpus/workload-specific surface. Retargeting the pattern at a new document domain = editing this block (plus your own documents) - no code changes. Values override the Bicep/script defaults; delete a key to fall back to its default. Docs: docs/01-architecture.md 'Adapting this pattern to another domain' and docs/13-configuration-reference.md section 3.2.
corpus.knowledgeSourceDescription: Searches the organization's indexed document collection (policies, procedures, reference material) and returns cited passages. Use it for any question answered by an internal document.

chatDeployment: <chat - only when a chat model is opted in>
searchPrincipalId: <auto-populated — AI Search system-assigned MI object ID>

fabric._note: Populated manually during docs/06-fabric-setup.md. The Fabric REST API has no Bicep/ARM surface for workspaces, lakehouses, or pipelines, so these IDs are recorded here as a reference for human re-use and for binding into pipeline parameters.
fabric.capacitySku: <F-SKU — F2 minimum for demo, F16+ recommended for prod>

sp-rag-di-caller._note: Populated manually after running `az ad sp create-for-rbac --name sp-rag-di-caller` (see docs/06-fabric-setup.md § F2.2). The SP is used by the Fabric OCR notebook to acquire a bearer token for Document Intelligence (served by the Foundry resource). NOTE: The `password` field below is the SP's client secret — it is ALSO stored in Key Vault as `di-sp-secret` (which is the canonical home; the Fabric notebook reads it from there at runtime). The copy here is kept temporarily for diagnostic convenience and SHOULD BE REMOVED once Key Vault retrieval is validated end-to-end.
sp-rag-di-caller.password: <sp-client-secret — also stored in Key Vault as `di-sp-secret`>

copilotStudio._note: Populated manually during docs/07-copilot-studio-setup.md. Copilot Studio is Power Platform (not Azure) and has no Bicep / Terraform surface.
